card.name: Words before resolved, and airway
card.fires_on: The word have or has after a symptom or toxicity noun in hold-until-resolved dosing text, and the word way after air in airway. Also a comma in a list of evaluation steps.

modes.label: Have/has before resolved
modes.description: Auxiliary verb after symptoms or toxicity, right before the word resolved in a withhold-until instruction.
modes.example: If symptomatic, withhold QINLOCK until symptoms<< have>> resolved and blood pressure is controlled.

modes.label: Airway
modes.description: The word way completing air in airway management or compromise.
modes.example: Maintain air<<way>>, provide adequate hydration and monitor renal function

modes.label: Comma in a list
modes.description: A comma after 'is not limited to' that introduces a list of evaluation steps.
modes.example: Evaluation of PML includes, but is not limited to<<,>> consultation with a neurologist, brain

card.plain: It fires on small words that sit just before a recovery word like resolved, and on the end of airway.
